response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord x ON x.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM t

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row counts as one analysed trade record; rows are included only if the linked transaction and trader both exist (inner joins), and the overall total is the sum over those matched rows.
Traders with a NULL tradekind would form their own group (NULL) and are kept in the total.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct transactions (transactionrecord rows) rather than advancedbehavior rows, in case several behaviour records link to the same transaction.
alternatives.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT x.transreg) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord x ON x.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM t
